facts.text: John visited Italy last month and found the food, history, and architecture to be amazing.

evidence.quote: Italy was awesome! Everything from the food to the history and architecture was amazing.

facts.text: John purchased a book in Italy that has been providing cooking inspiration.

evidence.quote: I even got this awesome book while I was there and it's been giving me some cooking inspiration.

facts.text: Tim is currently learning German and finds the structure of the language to be easier than French.

evidence.quote: I'm learning German now - tough but fun. Do you know any other languages?
Learning German has been tough but worth it. I like the structure of the language, it's much easier when I took French in high school.

facts.text: John knows some German and Spanish, and believes that knowing multiple languages makes travel easier.

evidence.quote: I know a bit of it myself and Spanish, it makes travel so much easier.
